status: five confirmed findings repaired; final integrated qualification and hash manifest pending

findings.title: Native read validation discarded extras and exposed input values
findings.counterexample: model_copy(update={unexpected: value}) extra was dropped by reconstruction from declared field names; direct model_validate on strict host models leaked invalid values/validator messages.
findings.repair: General BaseModel raw-graph revalidation and sanitized validation boundary for parameters/results; preserve exact parameter class check.
findings.disposition: fixed by parent; focused native/input redaction regressions observed

findings.title: Non-null hidden continuation components accepted null
findings.counterexample: Replace a non-null root Key component by None while retaining identity_digest: old input check skipped validation and next page could silently skip rows. Hidden sort outputs were also returned without carrier validation.
findings.repair: Validate every component against exact carrier and nullable flag both before dispatch and before issuing continuation; initial no-after placeholders remain distinct.
findings.disposition: fixed by parent; focused continuation controls observed

findings.title: Nested-only Fields admitted as projected row columns
findings.counterexample: Add tags array with tagItem nested Field and select tagItem in root projection: old root.fields.find admitted it though it is not an owned row member.
findings.repair: Require owned members in admission and emitter projection resolution; regression refuses nested-only projection.
findings.retractedHypothesis: A separate suspected ambiguity from sharing one owned Field across two Records was disproved by core KEY_MEMBER_OWNER rejection; it is not a finding.

findings.title: Native unique-index admission did not prove query equality
findings.counterexample: A text Key column with nondeterministic case-insensitive collation and UNIQUE INDEX(id COLLATE C) stores a and A, while query equality treats both equal. Old attribute-only index check accepted it, breaking to-one joins and keyset progress.
findings.repair: Require ready/valid/immediate unpredicated btree unique index, NOT NULL Key fields, built-in qualified opclasses matching carrier, exact index/column collation and deterministic Key collation.
findings.disposition: fixed; real PG18.6 regression passes for default, alternate-opclass, alternate-collation and nondeterministic a/A controls

findings.title: Generated query could bind to a different model generation
findings.section: build_query, CatalogRead.artifact and generated reference metadata
findings.counterexample: Generated Record/Field metadata had only schema/logical names, allowing model A query to build against different model B with matching names/carriers, or mix roots, joined refs and Key carriers from different generation inputs.
findings.repair: Immutable GeneratedSource carries exact document ID/core version/document SHA/input digest/runtime ABI through generated models/references and captured Key parameters/literals. Build checks every referenced cohort and binding model bytes before Weft; catalog carries local source metadata and load checks generated or explicitly supplied expected source.
findings.disposition: fixed; four focused source tests pass including stale/mixed/unpinned refs, Key parameter/literal retention and catalog restoration

qualificationLimits: Experimental scalar/to-one raw read profile only; trusted authored ReviewedSQL artifacts are not signed authority or complete CONTRACT-071 catalogs.
Native Key equality refusal is a narrow profile; it does not establish all type typmods, source-presence or native schema semantics.
Restore/incarnation and complete session/collation continuation identity remain open; host/port/database name/table OIDs alone are not restore detection.
Full native action execution, engine adoption, async/streaming/snapshot/search and Lakebase service qualification remain open.
Historical original and repaired-baseline receipts qualify only their own bytes.
